phase_name: Move the H1 per-phase limiter into orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh

objectives.description: Port the resume-scan conformance gate (blocked row on non-conforming headings)
Port the pre-dispatch marker/handoff crosscheck with disputed-heading downgrade
Port the H7 territory literal, threaded via --territory
Add --phase-number N to orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh (Phase Mission section)
Confirm one-blocking-phase-per-cycle holds by construction; record in header

approaches_tried.approach: Computed the H1 decision (blocked-reason / next_phase / territory) ONCE in a shared per-task loop before the dry-run/live fork, then filtered probed_dispatch into probed_dispatch_post_h1 for both loops to consume, rather than duplicating the heading-scan logic in each loop.
approaches_tried.reason: Matches the script's own header mandate of exactly one computation of every admission verdict; keeps dry-run and live buckets structurally guaranteed identical.

approaches_tried.approach: Initially left `h1_next_heading=$(grep ... | head -1)` unguarded against a no-match exit status.
approaches_tried.reason: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh runs under `set -euo pipefail`; a grep finding zero matches exits the whole script silently (no stdout/stderr) under errexit. Fixed with `|| true`, matching the `// 0`/`|| echo 0` guard idiom already used elsewhere in this same script for the identical hazard.

approaches_tried.approach: Deliberately did NOT port single-task H1's `elif last_skeleton` skeleton-exhaustion routing branch, and treated 'no open heading, not inconclusive' as an ORDINARY status-derived implement dispatch (not a no-dispatch fallthrough).
approaches_tried.reason: Neither is in this phase's own 8-item task list; recorded as a named, deliberate scope boundary in the script's own header comment (Scope Hypothesis confirmation) rather than a silent gap. orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's existing completion-claim gate already handles the non-skeleton 'all phases done' case correctly regardless of which path dispatched the last one.
